aurora-android-native-plugin.description: Allow Android thin/mobile runtime to read native Android status and policy wrappers. Wrappers call the native plugin without exposing raw Kotlin commands or secret getters.

aurora-audio-bridge.description: Allow audio bridge status checks for raw-audio permission UX without granting microphone capture, live streaming, or playback control.

aurora-command.description: Allow the frontend SDK adapter to proxy typed AuroraClient command requests to the configured Aurora Gateway origin.

aurora-dialogs.description: Allow dialog capability status checks without granting native open/save dialogs by default.

aurora-ios-native-plugin.description: Allow the frontend SDK adapter to invoke the Aurora iOS Swift native plugin capability, status, and concrete action handoff methods.

aurora-ios-voice.description: Allow iOS voice, invocation, and background-limit status checks without granting microphone capture, background listening, or system assistant ownership.

aurora-local-file.description: Allow local-file helper commands to return structured native-permission-missing responses without granting broad filesystem access.

aurora-log-tail.description: Allow the frontend SDK adapter to query non-secret sidecar log-tail availability without reading arbitrary files.

aurora-native-capability-manifest.description: Allow the frontend SDK adapter to read the Tauri shell capability manifest.

aurora-native-permissions.description: Allow the frontend SDK adapter to read the Aurora desktop native permission and capability status without granting denied OS surfaces.

aurora-native-webrtc.description: Allow the Python-free desktop thin shell to use the Linux native RTCPeerConnection/DataChannel fallback when the packaged WebKitGTK runtime omits the browser WebRTC API. Signaling, pairing, encryption, reconnect, and Aurora RPC remain in the shared TypeScript runtime.

aurora-notifications.description: Allow notification status checks and structured denied send responses without granting notification delivery by default.

aurora-overlay.description: Allow only Aurora overlay window visibility/status and narrow global hotkey registration commands. No shell, filesystem, process, or raw audio access is granted.

aurora-request.description: Compatibility permission for the legacy AuroraClient Tauri request bridge.

aurora-secure-file-handle.description: Allow secure file-handle helper commands to return structured native-permission-missing responses until a scoped handle design is implemented.

aurora-secure-storage.description: Allow Aurora credential helpers to persist auth/session, mesh, gateway, and admin-unlock secrets in the platform keychain. No web storage, filesystem, shell, or broad process permission is granted.

aurora-shutdown.description: Allow the main window to request a clean Aurora shell shutdown.

aurora-sidecar-session.description: Allow the frontend SDK adapter to fetch an in-memory sidecar command token. The token is not persisted or rendered.

aurora-sidecar-start.description: Allow the frontend SDK adapter to start the Rust-supervised local Aurora Python sidecar after sidecar-session token proof.

aurora-sidecar-status.description: Allow the frontend SDK adapter to read non-secret local sidecar health.

aurora-sidecar-stop.description: Allow the frontend SDK adapter to stop the Rust-supervised local Aurora Python sidecar after sidecar-session token proof.

aurora-subscribe.description: Allow the frontend SDK adapter to open, activate, and close the Aurora EventStream subscription bridge through the configured Gateway SSE route.

aurora-thin-peer-credentials.description: Allow thin WebView runtimes to store/delete/status opaque peer reconnect credentials, request challenge-bound reconnect proofs without returning raw bearer tokens, and store/retrieve the separately scoped room secret required to rebuild an approved WebRTC session.

aurora-thin-profile.description: Allow the desktop-thin shell to load and save only the nonsecret connection-profile document. This does not expose generic secure-storage get/set/delete or auth/admin/gateway secret keys.

aurora-tray.description: Allow the frontend SDK adapter to read system tray availability. Tray menu actions are handled in Rust and do not expose shell/process access.
